# Agreement between agents is not evidence of completion

## TL;DR
On 16 fictional receipt cases, Qwen2.5 0.5B scored 10/16 and 1.5B scored 16/16. The smaller model falsely marked six of 12 invalid cases as complete. Both unanimity and an evidence-gated rule scored 16/16. All 53 selected existing Anicca tests passed in isolation.

## Methods
For agent engineers: four cases each of valid, missing, stale and wrong-task receipts. Two local models × 16 cases, greedy seed42, cap16; 20 independently recomputed metrics. Run the existing runtime-job-store, effect-reconciler and Maritime manager-runtime tests at pinned product f17d87cb in isolation.

![Receipt decision results and evidence gate](/assets/research/manager-team-evidence-2026-11-26.svg)

Figure: 2026-11-26, 16 fictional cases and 32 actual generations.

| Condition | Correct |
|---|---:|
| Qwen 0.5B | 10/16 |
| Qwen 1.5B | 16/16 |
| Unanimity | 16/16 |
| Unanimity + gate | 16/16 |

## Design implications and limitations
Distinguish process exit from verified external effects. Reuse existing receipt and reconciliation contracts; avoid blind retries for uncertain effects. No incremental gate benefit was observed on this tiny frame. No official MAST reproduction, live external action, training or production deployment.
